policy.interpretation: Fixed exploratory signal thresholds, not flood probabilities or globally validated water mapping. Partial optical-water classes remain ambiguous. Spatial bootstrap intervals describe conditional resampling sensitivity, not causal or sensor-error confidence.

observations.assessment_selection: first observed acquisition in declared assessment window; not selected on signal magnitude

processing.aggregation: arithmetic linear gamma0 power, strict block support

pre.selection_policy: nearest date among >=50% usable-cell candidates; otherwise highest usable coverage; no SAR agreement criterion

provenance.class_semantics: Fractions of valid source cells assigned a class; partial water is not counted as full water and is excluded from strict binary comparison.

signature_summary.area_semantics: Nominal analysis-cell area of the specified mask, not independently retrieved inundation extent or water volume

matched_controls.criterion: unique baseline co-/cross-pol levels within declared dB tolerance; at most 16 nearest candidates; contrast uses matched positives only; not causal matching on all confounders

co_pol_contrast.interval_limit: Conditional resampling of fixed spatial blocks; spatial independence, measurement errors, reference errors and causal identification are not established

proxy_comparison.radar_comparator: first assessment minus median of declared baseline acquisitions

last_baseline_sensitivity.radar_comparator: first assessment minus last baseline acquisition; same policy thresholds, not an optimized alternative

artifacts.units: robust scaled deviation; not a Gaussian z-test

insights.observation: Median HH change on common radar support is -0.55 dB at 2026-07-26 relative to 3 baseline acquisitions.
insights.interpretation_limit: Signal change can reflect water, moisture, vegetation, management, geometry or processing. It is not a flood label.

insights.observation: 516 analysis cells have a strict new-open-water transition in the usable optical reference comparison; reference support covers 100.0% of radar support.
insights.interpretation_limit: Optical class shares, cloud exclusions and different acquisition dates limit the comparison; partial water is not treated as complete water.

limitations: This is a development characterization pilot, not a globally validated flood classifier or forecast.
Radar thresholds describe signal changes. Radar-signature area is not inundated area.
The optical product is independent of NISAR but has classification, cloud, temporal and mixed-pixel errors; agreement is not ground-truth flood accuracy.
Candidate controls are reference-stable predominantly nonwater cells matched on baseline radar levels; unmeasured confounders and intervening events remain.

Thermal-noise correction is not performed here. Missing SNR, terrain-visibility, land-cover and under-canopy water validation constrain physical interpretation; wind, wet soil and double bounce can change radar water response.
Persistence counts actual changed observations; gaps do not establish continuous flood duration. Signal return is not ecosystem or hydrologic recovery.
The first radar assessment is 2 day(s) after the reported event interval. A transient flood may have receded before observation.

context.description: PMD/FFD regional Chenab bulletin context. No independently surveyed flood polygon is supplied and local inundation is not assumed.
